scope: Established procedural geometry and surface priors relevant to the v10 curriculum. These sources provide no one-shot natural-photo recognition result.

sources.title: Superquadrics and Angle-Preserving Transformations
sources.mathematics: Signed powers of trigonometric coordinates control the shape of superellipsoids and supertoroids. Surface tangents define normals by a normalized cross product; cusps require care.
sources.adoption: Implemented superquadric families. The parameter remapping used for stable sampling is our numerical choice, not a new surface family.
sources.learning_budget: No machine-learning training or recognition benchmark.
sources.caveat: This established geometry supplies a prior; it does not establish transfer to unknown natural categories.

sources.title: A generic geometric transformation that unifies a wide range of natural and abstract shapes
sources.mathematics: The polar superformula varies angular symmetry and contour exponents; parameter choices determine closure and corner behavior.
sources.adoption: Researched extension only. Current radial_rosette uses explicit harmonics, not the Gielis superformula.
sources.learning_budget: No learned weights or image-recognition evaluation.
sources.caveat: A broad contour family is not a distribution of natural object semantics. Rational and asymmetric parameter choices require closure checks.

sources.title: Improving Noise
sources.mathematics: Gradient noise uses quintic interpolation 6t^5−15t^4+10t^3 with vanishing endpoint first and second derivatives, and a discrete gradient set.
sources.adoption: Future texture/displacement alternative only; v10 uses explicit Gaussian bumps plus grooves, not Perlin noise.
sources.caveat: Smooth interpolation controls derivatives, not realistic material statistics. No published source code was copied into v10.

sources.title: A Cellular Texture Basis Function
sources.mathematics: F_n(x) is distance to the nth nearest scattered feature point. F_2−F_1 supplies a cellular boundary cue, not exact distance to that boundary.
sources.adoption: Possible future cellular texture prior; not used by the frozen v10 renderer.
sources.learning_budget: Procedural graphics method; no learned model or one-image experiment.
sources.caveat: Feature-point statistics and spatial scale become designed priors. Surface parameter distances are not automatically geodesic distances.

originality_scope: The renderer, supervised shape/detail objective and controlled input-bandwidth experiment are an engineering combination. Neither superquadrics, Gaussian radial basis functions, FFT power descriptors nor contrastive learning are claimed as newly invented math.
